title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of AlMo0.5NbTa0.5TiZr refractory high-entropy alloys fabricated by laser melting deposition
process_description: prepared by electromagnetic induction heating-assisted laser melting deposition (LMD) with a lap ratio of 50%, a layer height of 0.5 mm, a powder flow rate of 5.8 g/min, a laser power range of 700 W–1600 W, and a scanning speed of 600 mm/min. The scanning strategy employed serpentine reciprocation, with the starting point exchanged at each layer and four layers completed in one cycle. The specimen temperature was maintained at 600 °C ± 10 °C using electromagnetic induction heating equipment.
